A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DIY-SC research. Text, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary material support reliable comparison. v1 Appendix A.1–A.7 maps to v3 Supplementary Sections A–G; the additional page does not represent additional experiments.

before.justification: v1 reports original semantic-correspondence evaluations on SPair-71k and AP-10k, ImageNet-3D training experiments, component ablations, and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains original benchmark results, ablations, qualitative comparisons, and supplementary experiments, including reduced-supervision and feature-channel evaluations.

M1.justification: The adapter, 3D-aware chaining, relaxed cyclic consistency, spherical rejection, sparse and dense losses, and ImageNet-3D adaptation remain unchanged. Revised diagrams and wording describe the existing procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use SPair-71k, ImageNet-3D, and AP-10k, retaining the intra-species, cross-species, and cross-family evaluations. The replacement bus example in Figure 4 remains within the existing appearance-change and repeated-parts scenario.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding tables and qualitative comparisons, including DINOv2, DIFT, SD+DINOv2, ASIC, SphMap, TLR, and DistillDIFT. The revised DINOv2 scores do not establish a change to the comparison method.

E3.justification: Both retain the bounding-box PCK metrics and averaging conventions, input resolutions, training budgets, and sampling settings, including 30k pairs per category and at most 50 sampled keypoints per pair. No protocol revision is documented for the changed DINOv2 results.

E4.justification: Figure 4(a) replaces the bus-pair case used to examine appearance changes and repeated parts, and retained panels show revised correspondence markers. Component ablations, failure cases, reduced-supervision experiments, feature-source and channel analyses, and supplementary Figures 5–6 are otherwise retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or removed.

E6.justification: Table 2 revises all DINOv2 category scores and its reported per-keypoint PCK@0.1 average from 46.5 to 55.6, without explaining the revision. Figure 4 also changes qualitative results. DIY-SC's Table 2 averages remain 74.4 and 75.1 with pretraining; numerical results in Tables 1, 3–5, 7–8 and supplementary prose are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–10 and the supplementary rotation-to-sphere conversion retain the same mathematical content. No definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are substantively added or revised.

C1.justification: Both retain the contributions of pseudo-label-based feature refinement, 3D-aware filtering, scaling through ImageNet-3D, and state-of-the-art SPair-71k performance. The conclusion's claimed gains of 4.5 per-keypoint and 6.8 per-image percentage points are unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations concerning complementary features, denser pseudo-label supervision, and generalization remain substantively unchanged. Both discuss spherical-prior limitations and failures involving vertically flipped objects and large perspective or scale changes; the appendix discussion is retained under new headings.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information is retained, including adapter architecture, optimizer settings, 200k-step SPair training, and ImageNet-3D training details. Project and rembg links are unchanged. Table 2's added pose-supervision reminder repeats information already documented in v1.

R1.justification: The same 66 cited works and substantive positioning relative to earlier correspondence and pseudo-labeling methods are retained. Bibliographic abbreviations and publication or author metadata updates do not introduce new related work.

P1.justification: v3 copyedits the abstract, introduction, method explanations, and experimental discussion, correcting awkward wording and typographical errors. Affiliations are expanded, and Appendix A.1–A.7 becomes Supplementary Sections A–G. The main narrative and section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: Figures 1–4 receive localized presentation changes, including an added sampling arrow in Figure 2, a more compact Figure 3, and revised imagery and spacing in Figure 4. Table 2 gains a supervision note, and Table 8 moves to a separate supplementary page. Main table structures and Figures 5–6 are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves readability and comparison transparency through cleaner prose, clearer diagram flow, and Table 2's explicit reminder that SphMap and DIY-SC require 3D pose annotations. The scientific evidence and limitations remain largely unchanged. The unexplained DINOv2 score revision is not itself evidence of improved validity, so the supported improvement is limited to presentation and clarity.
